Method of Attack: Malicious stand-alone JavaScript files signed using a malformed signature to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses, allowing malicious scripts to run and install malware automatically
Impacted Systems: Windows operating systems affected by Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
Attack Vector: Crafted malicious files evading MOTW defenses
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious stand-alone JavaScript files with malformed signatures; Exploitation campaigns spreading QBot trojan and Magniber Ransomware
